title: Response-Phase Fourier Factorization: Tensor Qutrit Dequantization, 1-Call Cyclic Autoregressive Chain Rule, and Signed 2-Call Pinching

scope.tensor_qutrit_product_factorization: Replacing cyclic F_{3^M} with tensor-product F_3^(tensor M) factorizes (F_3^dag)^(tensor M) D_y^(+-1) F_3^(tensor M) D_y |+_3>^(tensor M) into M independent 1-qutrit states computable in O(M) operations
scope.one_call_cyclic_autoregressive_chain_rul: The 1-call cyclic DFT state F_{3^M} D_y |+_D> satisfies the exact triangular autoregressive chain rule P(v_0,...,v_{M-1}) = prod_{k=0}^{M-1} P_k(v_k | v_0,...,v_{k-1}) with sum_{v_k=0}^2 P_k(v_k | v_{<k}) = 1 by Z_3 Parseval
scope.signed_two_call_difference_pinching: The signed (+1,-1) schedule pinches onto difference collisions; diagonal secret and error phases cancel but quadratic Fourier phases remain. No probability floor follows. A valid paired-row countercontrol refutes the former floor.
